blocks.html: Once a report is filled in, this is how you keep a copy, push it to the server, and get it to the people who need it.

slides.title: Save a local copy or upload
slides.html: At the bottom of the report, select Save & Close to keep a local copy, or the upload icon to Upload to the TAK Server. If several servers are configured you pick one; after upload the button greys out until you change something.

slides.title: Add or remove attachments
slides.html: Select Add New Attachment to add a photo, video, or file to the report. Select the Delete trash icon next to a file to drop it.

slides.title: Send the report
slides.html: Select the upload or send icon to choose how the report goes out: to a Contact, Select Server, Cloud/FTP, Choose App, or Export. Data Sync and Cloud/FTP only show up if those plug-ins are installed.

slides.title: Send via TAK Chat or copy the text
slides.html: Select the Send button for sending options. TAK Chat pushes the report to users on the network; Copy puts it on the clipboard to paste into any chat. For Data Sync, pick Data Sync Upload, choose a feed, then Send.

slides.title: Manage your saved reports
slides.html: Saved copies live in the Reports panel. Each report has its own row of icons: Upload, Details, PDF, Copy to Clipboard, Share, Visibility, and Delete.

slides.title: Make a PDF or copy the text
slides.html: Select PDF to generate a PDF of the report. Select Copy to Clipboard to drop the report as plain text into any Free Text or Contacts channel.

slides.title: Share via apps or delete
slides.html: Select Share to hand the report to any installed app that can send it. Select Delete to remove the report from the device. Visibility toggles the report marker on the map.
